hook: 3 Hemnes organizers under $20, ranked by drawer size

scenes.visual_prompt: Three products laid out side by side on a dresser top: clear bins, fabric bins, liner roll
scenes.voiceover: I tested three organizers against Hemnes's actual dimensions, not generic ones.

scenes.visual_prompt: Tape measure across the narrow top drawer showing 14 5/8 inches, Vtopmart bins being placed in
scenes.voiceover: For the narrow top drawers, the Vtopmart clear set tiles down small.

scenes.visual_prompt: Tape measure across the wide bottom drawer showing 30 5/8 inches, fabric bins being placed in
scenes.voiceover: For the wide bottom drawers, the fabric 6-pack handles the scale better.

scenes.visual_prompt: Liner rolled out under both drawer types in quick succession
scenes.voiceover: And the liner goes under both, no matter the width.

scenes.visual_prompt: Split-screen comparison graphic showing prices and star ratings for all three products
scenes.voiceover: Ratings range from 4.0 to 4.7 stars across almost 60,000 combined reviews.

scenes.visual_prompt: Fully organized dresser with all drawers open, showing the finished result
scenes.on_screen_text: Full comparison table on the blog
scenes.voiceover: Full breakdown with exact fit is on the blog.

scenes.visual_prompt: Closing shot of the dresser, CTA text appears

caption: I compared three Hemnes drawer organizers against IKEA's actual measurements instead of guessing — 16 1/8 inches deep, 14 5/8 to 30 5/8 inches wide. Here's which one goes in which drawer, with prices and ratings pulled straight from Amazon. Full comparison linked in bio. Contains affiliate links.
